setup: A length of \([[length]]\) is cut into \([[pieces]]\) equal pieces.

steps.say: Sharing equally is a division: \([[length]]\) divided by \([[pieces]]\). The fraction bar is that division sign, which is why the two notations are interchangeable.
Writing the division as a fraction and reducing gives \(\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}\). The answer is a fraction of a unit, not a count, because each piece is part of one length.

answer: So each piece is \(\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}\) of the original length.
